text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Gulf Arab citizens should be able to move freely between member states of the six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) in search of work, said GCC labour ministers meeting in Manama. The ministers also called for steps to increase job opportunities.
- Joint Arab petrochemical projects are key to the growth of Arab petrochemical industries, a Bahraini official said.
- Gulf Arab states will ask Japan to boost investments in the region when representatives of the Gulf states meet in Bahrain in March, officials said.
- Bahrain National Oil Company saw an 85 percent rise in net profits in 1996, the company chairman said.
- Arab Monetary Fund teams are due to visit Bahrain on Tuesday to discuss financing projects on the island worth 370 million dinars.
